prompt: A hopeful astronaut discovers a glowing ocean beneath Mars.

story.title: A Hopeful Astronaut's Discovery

scenes.title: Introduction
scenes.setting: A dusty, barren landscape on the surface of Mars, under a dark sky speckled with stars.
scenes.summary: The camera focuses on an astronaut standing near a newly established habitat. The astronaut, Alex, peers out through the visor of their helmet, eyes glinting with ambition and wonder. They hold a map displaying potential underground anomalies and plan an exploration mission to uncover Mars' mysteries.

scenes.title: Rising Action
scenes.setting: Inside a cramped yet high-tech rover, traversing the Martian surface.
scenes.summary: Alex navigates the rover over rocky terrain, guided by beeping instruments indicating an unusual energy source below. The vehicle's dashboard flashes with data, and Alex records a log entry, expressing excitement about the possibility of a groundbreaking discovery.

scenes.title: Climax
scenes.setting: A cavernous underground tunnel, dimly lit by the rover's headlights.
scenes.summary: Alex descends into a hidden cavern, stepping out to witness an astonishing sight—a vast, glowing ocean stretches before them, the water shimmering with an ethereal light. The astronaut removes a glove to touch the water, feeling its warmth and vitality, confirming life where none was expected.

scenes.title: Falling Action
scenes.setting: Back at the rover, now parked beside the glowing ocean.
scenes.summary: Sitting by the water's edge, Alex records a message back to Earth, sharing the monumental discovery. They reflect on humanity's quest for knowledge and the potential this revelation holds for future exploration and understanding of the universe.

scenes.title: Resolution
scenes.setting: A panoramic view of Mars, transitioning from the glowing ocean back to the surface.
scenes.summary: The camera pulls back to show the surface of Mars, with the rover parked near the entrance to the cavern. Alex is seen standing atop a ridge, gazing at the horizon. As the Martian sun begins to rise, the scene fades, symbolizing a new dawn for exploration and a hopeful future for humanity.
